original_prompt: Write an Ansible playbook that creates a non-root user 'deploy' with passwordless sudo, installs the user's public SSH key from a vault-encrypted variable, and disables password-based SSH login.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: Ansible playbook (YAML)

Task: Write an Ansible playbook that creates a non-root user 'deploy' with passwordless sudo, installs the user's public SSH key from a vault-encrypted variable, and disables password-based SSH login.

Output only the Ansible playbook (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
---
- name: Provision deploy user and harden SSH
  hosts: all
  become: true
  gather_facts: true

  vars:
    deploy_user: deploy
    deploy_user_shell: /bin/bash
    deploy_user_groups:
      - sudo
    # deploy_user_pubkey must be provided via Ansible Vault, e.g.:
    #   ansible-vault encrypt_string 'ssh-ed25519 AAAA...' --name 'deploy_user_pubkey'
    # deploy_user_pubkey: !vault |
    #   $ANSIBLE_VAULT;1.1;AES256
    #   ...

  pre_tasks:
    - name: Ensure deploy_user_pubkey is defined and non-empty
      ansible.builtin.assert:
        that:
          - deploy_user_pubkey is defined
          - deploy_user_pubkey | length > 0
          - deploy_user_pubkey is search('^(ssh-(rsa|ed25519|dss)|ecdsa-sha2-nistp(256|384|521)) ')
        fail_msg: "deploy_user_pubkey must be defined (via Ansible Vault) and contain a valid SSH public key."

    - name: Determine sudo group name by OS family
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        sudo_group: "{{ 'wheel' if ansible_os_family in ['RedHat', 'Suse'] else 'sudo' }}"

  tasks:
    - name: Ensure sudo is installed
      ansible.builtin.package:
        name: sudo
        state: present

    - name: Ensure sudo group exists
      ansible.builtin.group:
        name: "{{ sudo_group }}"
        state: present
        system: true

    - name: Create deploy user
      ansible.builtin.user:
        name: "{{ deploy_user }}"
        shell: "{{ deploy_user_shell }}"
        groups: "{{ sudo_group }}"
        append: true
        create_home: true
        state: present
        password: '!'
        password_lock: true

    - name: Ensure ~/.ssh directory exists with strict permissions
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: "/home/{{ deploy_user }}/.ssh"
        state: directory
        owner: "{{ deploy_user }}"
        group: "{{ deploy_user }}"
        mode: '0700'

    - name: Install authorized SSH public key for deploy user
      ansible.posix.authorized_key:
        user: "{{ deploy_user }}"
        key: "{{ deploy_user_pubkey }}"
        state: present
        exclusive: true
        manage_dir: true

    - name: Configure passwordless sudo for deploy user
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        dest: "/etc/sudoers.d/90-{{ deploy_user }}"
        content: "{{ deploy_user }} ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL\n"
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: '0440'
        validate: '/usr/sbin/visudo -cf %s'

    - name: Ensure /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d directory exists
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d
        state: directory
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: '0755'

    - name: Check if sshd_config includes sshd_config.d drop-in directory
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: "grep -E '^\\s*Include\\s+/etc/ssh/sshd_config\\.d/\\*\\.conf' /etc/ssh/sshd_config"
      register: sshd_include_check
      changed_when: false
      failed_when: false
      check_mode: false

    - name: Harden SSH via drop-in config (preferred)
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        dest: /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/10-hardening.conf
        content: |
          # Managed by Ansible - do not edit manually
          PasswordAuthentication no
          ChallengeResponseAuthentication no
          KbdInteractiveAuthentication no
          PermitRootLogin no
          PubkeyAuthentication yes
          UsePAM yes
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: '0644'
        validate: '/usr/sbin/sshd -t -f %s'
      when: sshd_include_check.rc == 0
      notify: Restart sshd

    - name: Harden SSH via main sshd_config (fallback)
      ansible.builtin.lineinfile:
        path: /etc/ssh/sshd_config
        regexp: "{{ item.regexp }}"
        line: "{{ item.line }}"
        state: present
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: '0600'
        validate: '/usr/sbin/sshd -t -f %s'
      loop:
        - { regexp: '^\s*#?\s*PasswordAuthentication\s+.*$', line: 'PasswordAuthentication no' }
        - { regexp: '^\s*#?\s*ChallengeResponseAuthentication\s+.*$', line: 'ChallengeResponseAuthentication no' }
        - { regexp: '^\s*#?\s*KbdInteractiveAuthentication\s+.*$', line: 'KbdInteractiveAuthentication no' }
        - { regexp: '^\s*#?\s*PermitRootLogin\s+.*$', line: 'PermitRootLogin no' }
        - { regexp: '^\s*#?\s*PubkeyAuthentication\s+.*$', line: 'PubkeyAuthentication yes' }
      when: sshd_include_check.rc != 0
      notify: Restart sshd

  handlers:
    - name: Restart sshd
      ansible.builtin.service:
        name: "{{ 'ssh' if ansible_os_family == 'Debian' else 'sshd' }}"
        state: restarted
